events.title: ZONE L.O.S.T. Demo - Hotfix #4 (v0.1.7)
events.summary: ZONE L.O.S.T. Demo - Hotfix #4 (v0.1.7)Hey everyone,Thank you for all the reports and clips about stutters and freezes - this update is built from them. Hotfix #5 is all about optimization: the game should run smoother, especially in co-op and while using voice chat.Smoother gameplay- Fixed small stutters that some of you had about once every second.- Fixed co-op sessions where players would stop seeing each other for a while. events.title: ZONE L.O.S.T. Demo - Hotfix #3 (v0.1.6)
events.summary: ZONE L.O.S.T. Demo - Hotfix #3 (v0.1.6) Hey everyone,Thank you for all the reports, logs and clips - this update is built almost entirely from them. The biggest fixes: players getting stuck on the ground after a knockdown (especially after the Grow gun), monsters running at about half their intended speed, and the blue screen on Intel graphics. Graphics- Intel graphics (Iris Xe, UHD and similar): turned off a rendering feature that did not work correctly on these GPUs. The game should now start

events.title: ZONE L.O.S.T. Demo - Hotfix #2.2 (v0.1.5)
events.summary: ZONE L.O.S.T. Demo - Hotfix #2.2 (v0.1.5)Hey everyone,Quick fix for the blue screen some of you saw: the level was not drawn at all (you could only see items and monsters), mostly on PCs where the Low graphics preset gets picked automatically. Thank you for the screenshots! - Fixed the blue screen / invisible level on all graphics presets.- Fixed black edges around the lobby mirror at a render scale below 100%. If you had the blue screen, just update and restart the game.The ZONE L.O.S.T. team

events.title: ZONE L.O.S.T. Demo - Hotfix #2.1 (v0.1.3)
events.summary: ZONE L.O.S.T. Demo - Hotfix #2.1 (v0.1.3)A quick follow-up to Hotfix #2 with two co-op fixes. Multiplayer- Fixed doors snapping back when a client let go of them: a door you pull open as a client now stays where you left it for everyone.- Fixed mousetraps not triggering correctly in co-op. The ZONE L.O.S.T. team

events.title: ZONE L.O.S.T. Demo - Hotfix #2 (v0.1.2)
events.summary: ZONE L.O.S.T. Demo - Hotfix #2 (v0.1.2)Hey everyone,Thank you for playing the demo, for streaming it and for every bug report. This round is about performance, Level 1 and the monsters: you told us the game could run smoother and that the monsters had swung too far the other way after Hotfix #1. We also fixed a number of things you found in co-op. Details below. Performance- New graphics presets in Options > Graphics: Low / Medium / High / Custom. The default is picked by your video memory.- Low
